notes: T0294 jobs-idempotency conformance fixture. Receipts, states and ledgers were computed at authoring time from the T0293 contract-derived reference engine (tests/test_t0293_jobs_idempotency_contract.py) over the linked queue contract. Malformed rows are discriminating: repairing the declared locus makes each row valid - one request field for set_request_field repairs; whole-request replace_request repairs are used only where the defect is not one settable field (non-dict request, field removal, runtime alias, multi-field conflict) and are not one-scalar-defect proofs. Rollback rows prove a rejected apply leaves the supplied state, ledger and request bit-identical before the valid follow-up commits. Queue-rejection rows prove the composed error domain: the queue's typed rejection propagates unwrapped and commits nothing.
